payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

decision.question: Does the edited image show the source mug itself moved to the right of the headphones, rather than merely adding another mug there?
decision.criteria: Compare the source and edited images to identify the source mug and assess its position relative to the headphones. Pass only when visual evidence reliably supports that the source mug itself is now to the right of the headphones. Fail when evidence reliably establishes that the source mug was not moved there, such as a clearly identifiable source mug remaining at its former position while a different mug appears on the right. Use unknown when the former-position blur, scale, lighting, appearance changes, or other ambiguity prevents reliable determination of the source mug's identity or movement. A mug appearing on the right alone does not establish that the source mug was moved.
decision.binding: Cross-image binding: the source image's blue mug, identifiable by its distinctive body and handle, and the same headphones visible in both source and edited images. Compare their corresponding regions and relative positions across images; allow for changes in scale, lighting, and appearance.
